facts.fact: Adam 提前给 Dautre 发了短信，向 Dautre 说明他们需要的东西。
facts.anchor: Adam had texted Dautre, explaining what they needed.

facts.fact: Dautre 回应 Adam 关于精灵宗教资料缺失的疑问：这种信仰被视为过时、不合时宜，但并没有被禁止。
facts.anchor: “That is passing strange,” Dautre said. “Such belief is considered archaic, out of fashion if you will, but it is not forbidden.”

facts.fact: Vic 穿着他的皮夹克前来赴约，这意味着他随身带着武器；他还带回了一对 flashlight。
facts.anchor: He was wearing his leather jacket, which meant he was armed.

facts.fact: 面对顶层被死锁闩死的门，Dautre 用手指抵住锁，霜随即覆盖锁体并把它弄裂（随后顶出门栓开了门）。
facts.anchor: “Allow me.” Dautre pressed a finger to the lock. Frost covered it and something cracked.

facts.fact: Wilcox 顶层套房里原有的保险柜已被取走，只在柜后留下一个方形的空位。
facts.anchor: There had been a safe, judging from the square-shaped space at the back.

facts.fact: 地下室受刑房里的尸体已经不见了，精灵把证据清理得干净得有点过头。
facts.anchor: The elves had cleared the evidence, perhaps a little too well.

facts.fact: Adam 的血迹被魔法彻底清洗（比漂白剂更彻底），他在房间里只感觉到一丝 Argent 的力量残留。
facts.anchor: Magic was more thorough than bleach, and he could sense just a little trace of Argent’s power in the room.

facts.fact: Adam 最终拿起那本书，说出『我们回家吧』，但他觉得自己说出来的声音已不像自己。
facts.anchor: Adam picked up the book. He didn’t think he sounded like himself when he said, “Let’s go home.”
